author: blueiridium.
content:
Hi all — I opened consensus-specs [#5828](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/issues/5828) about sync-contribution gossip after a missed slot immediately before a committee rotation. The executable gossip check appears to select the old committee from the stored head state, while boundary block processing uses the new committee. The issue includes signed spec reproduction results.

The released client paths I checked select the committee from contribution.slot + 1, so I’m raising this as a spec consistency question, not a demonstrated client exploit. I’d appreciate input on the intended gossip rule.
